verdict.rationale: Linear's docs show launch-coordination building blocks: initiatives with a lead team, statuses and priority; loops that update a launch plan and notify Slack when a project's target date changes; and subscriptions to project-view events. Nothing in the evidence documents explicit dependency tracking, such as blocking or blocked-by relations between issues or projects owned by different teams, so the story's core is only implied. Missing for 10: documented cross-team issue/project dependency relations, dependency visualization on roadmaps or timelines, alerts when an upstream dependency slips, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
